O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses, promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado, ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico, favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico. Inovar o varejo por meio da tecnologia é o que impulsiona a BCS SISTEMAS, e você pode ser parte dessa transformação. Estamos em busca de talentos criativos, proativos e estratégicos para integrar um projeto que visa desenvolver soluções móveis inteligentes, promovendo o uso efetivo de smartphones no dia a dia das operações do comércio varejista.

Você terá a oportunidade de atuar desde o mapeamento de processos e pesquisa de campo com lojistas e usuários do ERP, até a prototipação, desenvolvimento, integração e validação de aplicativos com tecnologias como nuvem, banco de dados, inteligência artificial, dashboards e notificações — tudo conectado ao ecossistema do nosso ERP.

Se você gosta de aliar tecnologia à experiência do usuário, tem familiaridade com soluções móveis e deseja causar impacto real em um setor essencial da economia, essa vaga é para você.

title: Página da Vaga | Engenheiro Dados Senior
description:
Job description

Mais do que simples fornecedores de tecnologia, nos destacamos como verdadeiros especialistas em logística. Nossas soluções são moldadas pela vasta experiência que acumulamos ao longo dos anos, refletindo a sabedoria e os aprendizados adquiridos ao longo de nossa jornada. É essa expertise que nos capacita a oferecer uma abordagem personalizada e altamente eficaz para cada cliente.

Por mais de 25 anos, trabalhamos com operações logísticas de grande escala, servindo a uma variedade de setores, incluindo indústrias, varejistas, operadores logísticos e transportadoras. Mantendo um olhar perspicaz sobre as tendências do mercado, desenvolvemos sistemas adaptáveis que se ajustam às necessidades em constante evolução de nossos clientes.

Nossa trajetória de pioneirismo ao longo dos últimos anos nos proporcionou um amplo know-how e expertise em todas as nuances do setor logístico. Essa jornada nos permitiu acumular valiosa experiência e nos destacar como líderes em oferecer as melhores práticas do mercado.

Além de nosso conhecimento aprofundado, a segurança é uma prioridade essencial para nós. Somos certificados pela ISO/IEC 27001, garantindo que adotemos os mais rigorosos padrões em segurança da informação, demonstrando nosso compromisso com a proteção de nossos parceiros e clientes.

Estamos em busca de profissionais apaixonados e determinados para se juntarem a nós como Engenheiro de Dados. Se você tem vontade de aprender, transformar a logística e mobilidade e fazer a diferença, essa é a sua oportunidade!

Main responsibilities

O Engenheiro de Dados Sênior será responsável por projetar, desenvolver e manter pipelines e arquiteturas de dados robustas, escaláveis e seguras. Atuará em estreita colaboração com o time de dados e as áreas de negócio para garantir a disponibilidade e confiabilidade das informações utilizadas em análises e produtos de dados.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver, orquestrar e monitorar pipelines de dados utilizando Apache Airflow , aplicando boas práticas de modularização e versionamento de DAGs.
  • Implementar rotinas de monitoramento e alertas (logs estruturados, métricas e notificações via Grafana, email, etc.).
  • Atuar na modelagem e implementação das camadas bronze, silver e gold em um Data Lake baseado em Databricks .
  • Construir e manter integrações de dados a partir de APIs REST, bancos relacionais, arquivos CSV/Excel/Parquet e filas de mensagens.
  • Desenvolver estratégias eficientes de carga incremental , controle de versionamento e catalogação de fontes.
  • Revisar e otimizar consultas SQL complexas em PostgreSQL e Oracle (PL/SQL) , garantindo desempenho e uso eficiente de recursos.
  • Trabalhar com object storage (S3) , definindo estratégias de versionamento, compactação e organização de arquivos.
  • Garantir a observabilidade e qualidade dos pipelines, com testes unitários e de integração e documentação técnica atualizada .
  • Participar de ritos ágeis e colaborar na modelagem de tabelas analíticas voltadas a ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Qlik) .

Experiências desejadas:

  • Vivência em ambientes de dados complexos, com múltiplas fontes e alto volume de informação.
  • Experiência comprovada na construção de pipelines de ETL/ELT em produção.
  • Atuação anterior com arquitetura em camadas (bronze/silver/gold) e governança de dados.

Requirements and skills

Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Domínio de Python para desenvolvimento de pipelines e automações.
  • Conhecimento avançado em SQL (consultas complexas, tuning, índices, CTEs, particionamento, views materializadas).
  • Experiência sólida com Apache Airflow (orquestração, versionamento, monitoramento).
  • Experiência com PostgreSQL e modelagem de dados para Data Lake.
  • Familiaridade com object storage (S3 ou equivalente) e formatos otimizados de arquivo (Parquet, ORC, GZIP).
  • Prática com Git e boas práticas de versionamento de código.

Desejável (diferenciais):

  • Conhecimento em Oracle/PLSQL .
  • Experiência com Databricks ou ambientes similares (Spark, Delta Lake).
  • Noções de Docker , DBT e monitoramento com Prometheus/Grafana .
  • Formação superior em áreas como Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou correlatas.
  • Certificações em cloud ou engenharia de dados (AWS, Azure, Databricks, etc.) serão consideradas um diferencial.

Additional information

O que esperamos de você:

Na nstech, temos uma cultura baseada em valores e esperamos que todos os colaboradores não apenas se identifiquem, mas também vivam essa cultura em seu dia a dia.

Nosso foco: foco no cliente, humildade, transparência, ética, trabalho em equipe, colaboração e resultados.

Por que fazer parte da nstech?

Visão de ser a plataforma de tecnologia para logística e mobilidade que conecta os elos da rede integrada de logística da América Latina.

Equipe de mais de 5 mil profissionais comprometidos em melhorar o mundo por meio da tecnologia aplicada à logística e mobilidade.

Oportunidade REMOTO, contratação CLT, benefícios como plano de saúde, odontológico, seguro de vida, refeição, Gympass e Zenklub, dia de folga no aniversário.

Vem fazer parte da nstech e dessa transformação!

description:
Location

Remote - US, New York

Employment Type

Full time

Department

Acquisition

Compensation

  • $60K – $65K

Here at Gaia, our employees are the foundation of our success. We believe it's super important that you are happy, healthy, and motivated.

As such, on top of a competitive market bench-marked salary, we offer private healthcare, fertility support and other benefits.

Additionally, we offer all new hires a set up budget in addition to an annual personal development budget to build your skills, knowledge, and potential. We’re working hard on our reward and recognition framework to make sure that those who are excelling above and beyond get what they deserve.

Our vision

Everyone who wants a family should have the chance to try. For the 1 in 6 families that struggle to conceive, fertility treatments are an option but they are expensive. We created the world’s first IVF insurance allowing more people who wish to be parents to pursue treatment with increased financial flexibility. Because the difference between having a child or not should not be how rich you are.

The role

From the very first moment someone considers Gaia as part of their fertility journey, we aim to offer clarity and care. That’s where you come in.

We’re looking for a BDR (Patient Support) to connect with prospects as they consider Gaia for their fertility journey.

You’ll be the first human touchpoint for patients early in their fertility journey; answering questions, building trust, and making sure they feel supported every step of the way.

This is a unique opportunity to support people at one of the most pivotal moments in their lives and help shape how Gaia shows up for them.

  • You’ll work closely with our Marketing team to manage the prospect pipeline for any patient starting their fertility journey in the early stages.

  • You’ll be acting as the main point of contact for prospects and guiding them seamlessly through the initial stages of their journey.

  • You’ll as a point of contact for clinic staff at your assigned clinics to support members book their initial consultations.

  • You’ll book initial calls between “ready to go” patients and our Member Growth Team.

Responsibilities

  • Manage a marketing pipeline of Gaia prospects.

  • Qualify potential members at their early stages throughout inbound forms and outbound sales calls.

  • Support MQLs to book a clinic consultation.

  • Book initial calls between Gaia Prospects and Member Growth Associates.

  • Manage all communication with Prospects via calls and email

  • Effectively carry out processes to track prospects\' initial journey and share data with clinics and the rest of the team.

  • Identify opportunities for increasing our sales pipeline to drive overall Member growth.

You’ll be a great candidate for this role if you:

  • Have minimum 1 year of experience qualifying leads and potential prospects over the phone and via inbound forms required .

  • Experience in the healthcare or fertility space (nice to have).

  • Are empathetic and deeply care about our Members - the IVF experience is incredibly stressful and empathy for what they are going through is a must.

  • Are a self-starter - you’ll be working as part of a small team but also a specific growth project, so we’ll be looking to you to help set us up for success

  • Have strong interpersonal skills - you’ll constantly be communicating with patients, clinic staff and the rest of our company via email and phone calls.

Compensation Range: $60K - $65K

By sharing insights, challenges, and wins early and often, we maintain transparency, solve complex problems faster, and keep our teams fully aligned. As a consultative expert , you will bridge the gap between our internal strategies and our external partners’ growth initiatives and business goals. By practicing intentional thought partnership and close collaboration, you’ll build strong, trusting relationships that ensure our clients feel heard, supported, and set up for success. Role Overview

As a Sr. Paid Social Acquisition Specialist , you will be a senior-level expert driving full-funnel paid social media strategies to fuel our clients’ growth. You’ll execute and optimize campaigns across major social platforms, ensuring they meet and exceed performance targets while aligning with broader marketing initiatives. With your strong communication skills, strategic thinking, and results-driven approach, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to integrate creative, retention, and conversion rate optimization efforts into cohesive campaigns.

This role offers a clear path to leadership – you’ll work alongside our Paid Media Manager (PMM) to accomplish key business objectives and initiatives, positioning yourself for future growth into roles like Paid Media Manager. If you’re a data-savvy, innovative marketer passionate about leveraging AI and rapid experimentation to scale DTC brands, this opportunity is your next big challenge.

Key Responsibilities

  • Paid Social Campaign Execution & Optimization: Plan, launch, and optimize paid social campaigns across platforms (e.g., Facebook/Instagram, TikTok) to drive customer acquisition and retention. Implement audience segmentation, targeting, messaging, and bidding strategies, continuously A/B testing creatives and audience approaches to maximize engagement and conversions. Ensure all campaigns align with client goals and WKND’s performance benchmarks for measurable outcomes.
  • Full-Funnel Strategy & Cross-Functional Collaboration: Align paid social initiatives with broader direct-to-consumer growth strategies, ensuring a cohesive full-funnel approach from prospecting to retention. Work closely with creative, email/SMS, conversion rate optimization, SEO, and content teams to integrate campaign efforts and share insights. Ensure consistent messaging and leverage cross-channel learnings to improve marketing efficiency and customer lifetime value.
  • Data Analysis & KPI Management: Leverage advanced analytics platforms and AI-driven tools to monitor campaign performance and inform optimizations. Track and analyze key metrics – including return on ad spend (ROAS), customer acquisition cost (CAC), marketing efficiency ratio (MER), click-through rate (CTR), average order value (AOV), and CAC-to-LTV ratio – adjusting budgets and strategy to exceed targets. Use data-driven insights to make timely optimizations that improve ROI and scale results.
  • Insightful Reporting & Presentations: Compile and present detailed performance reports that translate complex data into clear, actionable insights. Create visually compelling presentations for internal teams and clients, highlighting campaign results, trends, and strategic recommendations. Communicate the story behind the numbers, enabling informed decision-making and demonstrating the value of our paid social efforts.
  • Client Communication Support: Support the Paid Media Manager in delivering top-notch client service through effective communication. Participate in occasional client calls or meetings to provide updates, explain campaign performance, and answer questions with professionalism and clarity. Help maintain transparent, trusting relationships by ensuring clients understand campaign progress and value.
  • Strategic Initiative Execution: Partner with the PMM to execute key business initiatives and special projects in paid media. Translate high-level objectives into actionable campaign plans and take ownership of their successful implementation. Proactively contribute ideas and optimizations that drive business goals, demonstrating leadership potential and a commitment to continuous improvement.

Who You Are

  • AI-Driven Innovator: You’re passionate about leveraging AI and automation to push the limits of what's possible, always looking for ways to deliver scalable, cutting-edge solutions that drive success.
  • Tech Visionary: You thrive in environments that challenge you to innovate, embracing new technologies and harnessing them to create transformative, future-proof SaaS platforms.
  • Creative Problem Solver: You’re not afraid to think outside the box, tackling complex challenges with fresh perspectives and finding solutions that have a lasting impact.

  • Results-Oriented & Data-Driven: You’re obsessed with data, continuously interpreting metrics to relentlessly optimize campaigns and drive unparalleled ROI. You’re not just meeting targets—you’re exceeding them.
  • Platform Proficiency & Digital Mastery: You’re a wizard across paid platforms like Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok, and more, with a sharp understanding of AI-driven optimization tools that push performance to new heights.
  • Proactive & Adaptable: You’re always ahead of the curve, staying on top of platform changes and anticipating challenges before they arise. You pivot with agility, turning potential obstacles into growth opportunities

Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing or a related field (required) .
  • Experience: 5+ years of hands-on performance marketing experience in paid social (required) , with a deep understanding of paid acquisition and media buying strategies. Proven ability to scale campaigns, manage substantial budgets, and consistently meet or exceed key performance targets.
  • Technical Skills: Highly knowledgeable in bidding and targeting automation tools; proficient in Google Analytics and other ad management/testing platforms.
  • Soft Skills: Excellent project management and problem-solving capabilities. Ability to structure complex, multi-stakeholder projects effectively. Strong written and verbal communication skills for both client-facing and internal collaboration.
  • Performance Culture: Thrive in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities, demonstrating a strong sense of ownership and effective time-management.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive Base Salary: Calibrated to attract top talent who thrive under high expectations.
  • Generous Stock Options: Align your success with the company’s trajectory and shared prosperity.
  • Performance-Based Bonuses: Earn additional rewards for surpassing key growth milestones and metrics.
  • Access to Advanced Development Tools & Resources: Stay on the cutting edge with the latest AI-driven marketing technologies.
  • High-Performance Culture: Be part of a team where your contributions are noticed, celebrated, and rewarded for driving real impact.
  • Healthcare & Wellness Options (available upon request): Designed to support your well-being and peace of mind.
  • Flexible Work Environment: Work remotely or in-office, as long as you meet deadlines and deliver exceptional results.

Ready to Shape the Future of Paid Acquisition & Paid Social — And Revolutionize with AI?

Join WKND as a Senior Paid Social Acquisition Specialist and become a pivotal force behind high-performing, AI-enhanced campaigns for top DTC brands. You won’t just execute ads—you’ll help shape strategy, pioneer new approaches in paid social, and contribute to our bold shift toward an AI-driven SaaS model.

If you’re passionate about delivering transformative outcomes, driving exponential growth, and advancing your career in a cutting-edge environment, WKND is where you belong .

description:
Job Description

Store Setup Team Leads assist their supervisor and other Store Setup leads with the merchandising of new, remodeled and relocated Advance Auto Parts stores. Team leads are responsible for individual parts of the larger project plan, to set a store to be ready for open. They lead a portion of the local team or contracted support staff to complete segments of the store. As an example, a Team Lead will Co-lead store team members and contracted support that are completing activities on the retail sales floor, while another Team Lead is responsible for leading merchandising activities in the areas behind the retail counters. A Store Setup team consists of one Supervisor, and three SSU Leads reporting to them.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Other duties may be assigned.

  • Co-leads teams of local Advance Auto Parts Retail Team Members and contracted support to successfully set up a new a portion of an Advance Auto Parts, Carquest, or other acquired companies stores/branches to company and department standards
  • Trainslocal team members and contract support on proper merchandising techniques. Helps direct them in their day-to-day assignments
  • Builds Gondolas and Backroom storage shelving according to floor plan.
  • Directs all work related to their segment of the project.
  • Must document (written) any noncompliance with company policy or procedure by an employee within forty-eight (48) hours of occurrence and notify their Store Setup Supervisor (contact supervisor or Human Resource if in doubt)
  • Must be willing to travel 80-100% of the time
  • Reconciling travel and business-related expenses

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Co-leads 2-10 internal or outsourced team members during assignments. Is responsible for assisting in the overall direction, coordination, and evaluation of the team. Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include - Interviewing, hiring, and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems.
  • To maintain a positive attitude, set a professional example, and promote proper work ethics for team members and operations personnel at all times to follow.
  • Must be comfortable leading in a matrixed environment
  • Verify all plan-o-grams are correct, current and built to plan. This includes signage, display racks, and specialty display items. Any errors in plan-o-gram accuracy should be reported to the plan-o-gram department and fixed on site.
  • Is responsible for keeping expenses to a minimum following department and company guidelines. This includes motel, travel, meals, tools, supplies and payroll.

QUALIFICATIONS - To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE

  • High school diploma or general education degree (GED); 2-4 years related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

LANGUAGE SKILLS

Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals. Ability to write routine reports and correspondence. Ability to speak effectively before groups of customers, Outsourced reps or employees of organization.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

  • Must possess a valid driver’s license.
  • Must be willing to be certified as a forklift operator

OTHER QUALIFICATIONS

  • Must be able to travel as store schedule requires. Travel may require being away from home for 8 to twelve days at a time. Typical schedule is 8 days but can vary depending on project type.
  • Must comply with all company policies and procedures and set a professional example.
  • Follow all security and safety practices at all times

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand; walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb ladders or balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; and talk or hear. The employee is occasionally required to sit. The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 25 pounds, frequently lift and/or move up to 50 pounds, and occasionally lift and/or move up to 100 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, and color vision.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently exposed to high, precarious places. The employee is occasionally exposed to outside weather conditions, extreme cold, and extreme heat. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

Você realizará atendimento de orientação médica telefônica através de uma abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos.

  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.

  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.

  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.
  • Manter-se bem informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.
  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.

Formação Acadêmica

Obrigatório: RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO CONCLUÍDA EM MEDICINA DA FAMILIA.

Job Details

Company Overview

With core values based on People, Product, Pride and Perseverance , BASX located in Redmond, OR, was founded in 2014 by two entrepreneurial engineers who had a vision for providing precision air handling systems. Fast forward just 10 years, BASX, now an integral part of AAON, is an industry leader in the innovative research, development, design and manufacturing of custom heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC) solutions.

Our goal is to partner with companies, in a wide range of industries such as data centers, clean rooms and surgery centers, who come to us with complex challenges that need to be resolved. Our team has a world-class reputation for manufacturing custom HVAC solutions that exceed our customers' needs and expectations, and we are proud to manufacture over 90% of our units, from start to finish, right here in beautiful Central Oregon.

Our team is rapidly increasing, from 200 employees in 2022 to over 800 today, to meet the demand for our innovative solutions, and we are looking for talented individuals within a broad range of specialties to continue this incredible growth.

If you are looking for a job in a dynamic, fast-paced, growing, and fun environment where you can develop and hone your skills, we want to meet you. Our team enjoys flexible shift schedules and generous benefits, including medical, dental and vision, and short- and long-term disability as well as both a 401(k) and an HSA (Health Savings Account) with a 175% employer match . We welcome people who have a passion for ingenuity, perseverance, and pride, and who love innovation and the satisfaction of knowing their work matters.

Job Summary

The Director of Customer Care leads the customer care department, ensuring exceptional service delivery across order entry, warranty management, technical support, customer service, and field service. This role is pivotal in enhancing customer satisfaction, loyalty, and retention for BASX products and solutions manufactured across our fleet of factories.

  • Monitors customer feedback and develops strategies to address areas of concern.

  • Oversees the field service technician team, ensuring timely and effective service delivery.
  • Coordinates training and development programs for field technicians to maintain high service standards.
  • Monitors field service performance and implements improvements as needed.

Education and Experience Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field (Master's degree preferred), and 10 years of experience in sales, customer care, technical support, or a related field, with 4+ years in a leadership role.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

Key Responsibilities:

Deal Review & Structuring

  • Review and validate sales opportunities in Salesforce/CPQ or ERP, ensuring accurate product configuration, pricing, margins, and documentation.
  • Advise Sales on deal structures, acceptance criteria, and contractual terms that impact bookings and revenue recognition.

Order Processing & Fulfillment Coordination

  • Review and process customer Purchase Orders (POs) in accordance with company policies and compliance standards.

  • Process internal/demo sales orders and ensure all orders are properly documented in ERP/CRM systems.
  • Monitor delivery milestones and coordinate with Billing for timely invoicing.

Revenue Forecasting & Tracking

  • Maintain and update the Revenue Schedule at the start of each quarter and on a weekly basis to reflect deal changes.
  • Consolidate input from Sales, Professional Services, Finance, and Supply Chain to support accurate revenue forecasting.
  • Track project completion, acceptance milestones, and payment status to ensure timely revenue recognition.

Cross-Functional Coordination & Reporting

  • Lead or participate in weekly meetings to track deal progress, delivery timelines, technical issues, and payment updates.
  • Work closely with Credit Management on credit checks and customer credit status.
  • Support RFP reviews with financial and operational input.

Skills & Requirements

  • Experience: 2+ years in revenue operations, order management, sales operations, deal desk, or similar roles.

Preferred Experience

  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies and experience working in an agile development environment.
  • Prior experience working in a collaborative, cross-functional team setting.

This position provides an exciting opportunity to work on advanced data engineering projects, contribute to the success of complex data initiatives, and grow your career while mentoring others. If you are passionate about Snowflake and enjoy working with cutting-edge technologies, we encourage you to apply.

Accounts Payable & Receivable : Processing invoices, applying payments, and reconciling transactions accurately and efficiently.

NetSuite : Utilize NetSuite for bank feeds, reconciliations, accounts payable and receivable processing, generating reports, and posting journal entries. This includes running balance sheets and profit & loss reports, entering invoices and bills, and creating customers and vendors.

Communication and Task Management : Using Asana to update and manage tasks and Bizinta for time entries with detailed descriptions.

Requirements

2–3 years of accounting or finance experience doing month-end close processes, bank reconciliations, and intercompany transactions.

Strong proficiency in NetSuite (or similar ERP) and Excel.

Strong background in process enhancement, process implementation, and system optimization.

Fluent in English, both written and spoken, with excellent attention to detail and analytical skills.

Strong understanding of debits / credits, journal entries, and accrual-based accounting.

US GAAP knowledge required; IFRS familiarity is a plus.

Ability to work independently while collaborating with a remote team.

Working Equipment to start is required.

Working hours based on client

Career development through mentoring, training, and long-term growth opportunities.

At TGG Accounting, our mission is to make business owners’ lives better through excellent financial management. We provide outsourced accounting and advisory services to small and mid-size businesses, helping them build strong financial foundations, plan for growth, and make better decisions.

We are more than 250 teammates, located across the U.S. and around the world in the Philippines, Argentina, Ecuador, Chile, Brazil, Peru, and Mexico, working together in a vibrant, multicultural environment to deliver on our mission.

Position Summary

The Senior Regulatory Writing Specialist is a professional responsible for the creation of regulatory materials for investigational and marketed products in alignment with regulatory and compliance practices. The individual will work directly with client teams to manage regulatory writing projects.

Essential Functions

  • Regulatory writing skills with mastery of 3 or more regulatory document types (eg, clinical study protocols, clinical study reports, briefing documents, IND, NDA, and MAA components).

Core cross-functional clinical research roles and procedures, and how they relate to document preparation. Acts as a primary writer and/or project manager for key documents and projects.

Organizes and leads cross-functional document review meetings, clarifies and incorporates feedback, and works with cross-functional subject matter experts to resolve unclear comments and differences of opinion between functional areas.

Above average attention to detail, teamwork and initiative. Ability to interact with other departments within the company and be proficient in written and verbal communication. Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, Power Point and Outlook, and quickly able to learn new software. Ability to apply regulatory guidelines to content development.

Skills and Abilities

Education: Advanced degree in a scientific discipline (e.g., life sciences, pharmacy, medicine) or relevant work experience; or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.

Experience: More than 2 years (typically 3-5 years) of experience in scientific/medical/regulatory writing in the pharmaceutical domain.

Computer Skills: Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

The Escalation Manager position is a strategic, high-visibility role that provides the highest level of escalation for customer issues that are jeopardizing the Palo Alto Networks business relationship and / or sales opportunities with key customers.

The Escalation Manager will lead and manage the resolution of customers' critical issues by forming and leading an interdepartmental, cross-functional, and geographically dispersed Palo Alto Networks virtual team which are formed based on the customer and escalation needs.

In leading the virtual team, the escalations Manager will liaise with and work across various Palo Alto Networks functional organizations and business units, and with all levels of the company; from Support, Sales, Product management, and development engineers to management and corporate executives.

Escalation Leadership

Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues

Drive clear intake, scope, priority, exit criteria and end to end process to achieve streamlined escalation resolution

Drive global consistency across portfolio and customers

Maintain and improve procedures for customer and field personnel for escalation handling

Handle direct customer leadership and technical audiences as appropriate

Expedite Resolution

Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations

Strong ability to influence and be effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account and issues

Clear accountability on relevant owners on driving to target service-level Objectives(SLO) and intermediate milestones leading up to it

Interlock with Executive Sponsors to help resolve roadblocks in a timely manner

Communication and Reporting

Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales, support, product teams and other invested parties

Effective use of dashboards and keen understanding of how to use data to help deliver the outcomes needed and track progress towards SLO

A “whatever it takes” customer-first attitude and a willingness to go the extra mile to foster customer success

Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives

Retrospective and Preventive Measures

Retrospectives and PostMortem to help improve the process / system / product

Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and / or processes and drive actions to prevent future problems

Recognitions and reporting on problem areas which will give insight to the magnitude of the issue through the amount of cases or number of customers impacted or related to these areas

Understanding of techniques to predict risks using data and AI models and systematic approach to address

Co-create and pilot proactive programs to reduce likelihood of customer and field escalations

Fully fluent in Portuguese, English, and Spanish both written and verbal

Customer Experience

10+ years of customer-facing sales and / or service delivery roles

Past experience as Escalations Engineer / Manager, Technical Account Management, Engineering Management, Customer Support Management, or similar roles desired

Customer centric attitude and focus on providing best-in-class service for customers and collaborators

Program / Project management

Manage critical issues in a cross-functional environment that includes working with support, customer success, professional services, sales, customers, and partners to resolve complex and critical issues

Ability to multitask and prioritize with a goal of driving issues to closure on behalf of the customer

Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, Asana, Tableau, JIRA and experience in running and operating with the SLA / SLO / Milestones paradigm and clarity on what success and corresponding metrics looks like

Collaboration and Influence

Strong capacity for Influencing, negotiating, and delegating efforts

Ability to work in a fast-paced, challenging environment with global customers

Leadership and communication skills

Experience in being able to effectively lead and motivate a team of cross functional professionals

Expertise in communicating complex topics in a clear and concise manner to different tiers of audiences(highly technical, less technical, executives, practitioners)

Technical skills

Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues

Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations

Creative thinking, adaptability, and versatility

Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives

Strong ability to influence and effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account

Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and / or processes and drive actions to prevent future issues

Additional Information

The Team

The Escalation Managers are part of the Global Incident and Escalation Management team which part of Global Customer Support and Service teams covering all Palo Alto offerings of cybersecurity platforms and solutions.

Team is responsible for driving expedited response, remedy, resolution, and learnings for our most critical issues. Escalation Managers(EM) team ensures focused technical leadership, effective coordination and communication, and streamlined decision-making

As Escalation Managers, each team member will be at the vanguard of our dedication to cybersecurity. Addressing the most pressing situations for our customers, you will hold a central position in solidifying our reputation as the go-to cybersecurity partner. This role demands proactivity, efficiency, an unwavering dedication to constant refinement, and a passion for customer satisfaction.

Driving continuous learnings and efficiency into the Escalation Management and Product Lifecycle is one of the key areas for the team as we continue our focus on customer experience.

We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple : we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

Our people at JLL and JLL Technologies are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

About JLL

We’re JLL. We’re a professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We help organizations around the world achieve their ambitions by owning, occupying and investing in real estate.

We’re a Fortune 500 company. We work across 80 countries, in 280 different offices, with a team of over 92,000 individuals. And we look after a property portfolio of over 4bn square feet, all on behalf of our clients.

If you’re looking to step up your career, JLL is the perfect professional home. At JLL, you’ll have a chance to innovate with the world’s leading businesses, put that expertise into action on landmark projects, and work on game‑changing real estate initiatives. You’ll also make long‑lasting professional connections through sharing different perspectives, and you’ll be inspired by the best. We’re focused on opportunity and want to help you make the most of yours. Achieve your ambitions – join us at JLL! JLLT has an ambition to deliver $1 billion in revenue, Sourcing and Procurement is a key component of helping to support this strategic goal.

About JLL Technologies

JLL has a global IT function which spends over $500 million per annum. The role entails working with JLLT leadership team to develop key strategies that help to fully leverage expenditure, build an enterprise operating model that helps JLLT achieves its goals, manage risk, consider balance of trade considerations and how expenditure can be evolved further. All sourcing and procurement needs to be done against the backdrop of JLL governance and S&P guidelines.

Global Category Manager – Software

Develop, manage and execute global category sourcing strategies within the specific IT Category allocated. As the Software Category Manager you will be responsible for building relationships with the CIO’s, CTO’s, Chief Product Officers, building internal demand plans, developing category plans including new opportunities and manage relationships with key strategic suppliers. Ensure contracting and procurement standards are maintained throughout the portfolio.

Summary of essential functions and Goals

  • Partner with the JLLT leadership team to create category strategies that align with JLLT’s key fundamental plans whilst leveraging growing expenditure to have commercial advantage

  • Develops & regularly maintains/up‑dates short-, mid- and long‑term category strategy globally, linking this strategy with overall business strategy/objectives, in alignment with departmental stakeholders (C‑suite)

  • Category Manager has and/or forges key strategic relationships with (strategic) suppliers/industry leaders and develops those relationships on behalf of JLL being mindful of long‑term mutually beneficial and ethical objectives as well as providing the business with access to supplier innovation

  • Category Manager is responsible for leading the approval process for third party expenditure. This includes presenting the deal to senior leaders in the business such as the JLLT CEO, Global CFO and Global CPO

  • Category Manager is leading key strategic procurement projects and provides expert advice and guidance to the JLLT leadership team. Advice has expanded from pricing and commercial principles to incorporate aligning supplier/partner strategies to make/buy decisions & managing sensitivities where JLL’s strategy could create direct conflict against the suppliers value proposition

  • The Category Manager will recommend the qualification of appropriate service providers/supply partners to ensure that we have the best service provision available across the region to deliver value to our internal and sometimes also external clients

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Responsible for global category strategy development, execution and category performance of all category related activities & objectives for corporate category requirements as well as other JLL entities if required. Ensuring alignment across the JLLT Leadership team

  • Delivery of financial targets in line with business expectations. Category Manager continuously drives the category opportunity agenda and self‑sufficiently identifies, agrees and executes these projects

  • Accountable for creating strategic solution for specific commodity/service requirements, procurement event planning, RFP/quotation management, bid analysis and recommendations, liaison with internal stakeholders for contract approvals, savings reporting, documentation and compliance.

  • Create and manage the category project calendar, lead category events, bid process, commercial evaluation, recommendations, contract document preparation and functional reviews

  • Approvals according to JLL Delegation of Authority. Compliance with JLL procedures as applicable. This includes presenting and seeking approval from Global CEO of JLLT, Global CPO and Global CFO

  • Rationalizes supply base and develops clear strategic supply partner framework and maintains this framework at senior supplier level

  • Use Global, Regional and Country, market and industry intelligence to identify and qualify new suppliers and use data to support the business and delivery of services. In addition, identify risk, threats and provide solutions for mitigation.

  • Provide functional leadership and peer group alignment, where appropriate and needed

  • Identify opportunities to develop and implement new policies and procedures, including rationalization of legacy policies and procedures

  • Actively engage in and support the use of e‑procurement strategy, methodology and deployment

  • Prepare high quality papers and presentations for use with internal and external stakeholders and/or teams as required

  • Apply ethical company standards and ensure Global Procurement policy is applied at all times

Ability to Manage the Sourcing Process

  • Develop category plan with the ability to provide visibility such as supplier summaries, stakeholder engagement plans, contract summaries, and market insights that lead to both short and long‑term strategies

  • Ability to negotiate and have proven strategies within areas of corporate spend

  • Lead development and execution of all sourcing‑related functions: performing due diligence and assessment of prospective suppliers, executing RFPs/bids, negotiating contracts and ensuring effective transition to operations during implementation

  • Partner with CIO’s and the business to drive both immediate and sustained benefits to JLL Corporate

  • Bring strategic thought leadership to identify additional cost and operational efficiencies. Individual must be able to consider bigger picture goals and scenarios. The individual has to be able to clearly articulate and advise senior members of JLL on decisions that could impact business line performance

  • Proactively manage internal stakeholder expectations and escalation at appropriate times

  • Savings – working with sourcing managers and key suppliers, ensure that savings initiatives ideas are being driven to maximize savings impacts

  • Ensure that the savings tracker across country is kept up‑to‑date for the category so that we can demonstrate value add to our internal stakeholders

  • Conduct Preferred Supplier performance review meetings, manage supplier scorecards, contract compliance and service obligations

  • Subject matter expert for category and considered to be the channel of choice within JLL

Sound like you? To apply you need to have:

  • Excellent Inter‑personal skills, Organization skills, Strong gravitas and influencing skills with senior business leaders

  • Ability work on a global scale and across different regions. This includes the ability to meet and align category plans with global vertical stakeholders

  • Excellent communication skills – oral and written

  • Proven ability to facilitate strategic supplier relationships and work with senior business executives and across procurement leadership

  • Collaborative and influencing style with a focus on team work

  • Proven ability to deliver results in challenging environments

  • Expertise in sourcing with demonstrated ability to manage change

  • Ability to sell and present initiatives and/or new ideas

  • Experience in sourcing indirect corporate services and products

  • Excellent PC skills, proficient in MS applications with excellent ability to work with large amounts of data and build reports

  • Bachelor's degree (BA/BS) from four‑year college university

  • Minimum 7 years of strategic sourcing experience (majority within IT and technology)

  • CPSM certification preferred

  • MBA preferred

Location

  • Role to be based in North America (USA or Canada)

  • As part of the role, individuals must have the flexibility to deal with projects in different time zones and manage their time accordingly

What you can expect from us

You’ll join an entrepreneurial, inclusive culture. One where we succeed together – across the desk and around the globe. Where like‑minded people work naturally together to achieve great things.

Our Total Rewards program reflects our commitment to helping you achieve your ambitions in career, recognition, wellbeing, benefits and pay. We’ll offer you a competitive salary and benefits package.

Join us to develop your strengths and enjoy a fulfilling career full of varied experiences. Keep those ambitions in sights and imagine where JLL can take you…

Apply today!

Estimated compensation for this position:

110,000.00 – 135,000.00 USD per year

This range is an estimate and actual compensation may differ. Final compensation packages are determined by various considerations including but not limited to candidate qualifications, location, market conditions, and internal considerations.

Location:

  • Remote –Atlanta, GA, Boston, MA, Chicago, IL, Los Angeles, CA, Milwaukee, WI, New York, NY, Raleigh, NC, San Francisco, CA, Seattle, WA

If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet all the requirements. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!

Accepting applications on an ongoing basis until candidate identified.

Personalized benefits that support personal well‑being and growth:

  • 401(k) plan with matching company contributions

  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental & Vision Care

  • Paid parental leave at 100% of salary

  • Paid Time Off and Company Holidays

title: QA Lead (100% Remote)
description:
About the Job
QA Lead is responsible for overseeing the quality assurance function across Tether Data. This role ensures that product releases meet defined quality standards through the development and execution of test strategies, frameworks, and automation. QA Lead works closely with the teams, Dev‑Ops and Product to embed quality throughout the development lifecycle.
QA Lead serves as the quality champion within Tether Data and plays a key role in shaping the overall testing culture and processes.

Responsibilities

  • Define and Drive QA Strategy: Establish and continuously refine the overall QA vision, goals, and strategy to align with product and engineering objectives, balancing manual and automated testing approaches.
  • Plan and Manage Testing Activities: Oversee test planning, prioritization, and execution across projects. Ensure test coverage aligns with business impact, release timelines, and risk assessment.
  • Mentor and Guide QA Engineers: Provide technical and procedural guidance to QA Engineers, fostering skill development in both manual and automation testing. Conduct regular reviews and coaching sessions.
  • Ensure Quality Governance and Standards: Define QA processes, templates, and best practices to standardize testing across teams. Maintain consistency in documentation, defect management, and reporting.
  • Collaborate with Cross-Functional Teams: Work closely with product managers, developers, and DevOps to ensure quality is embedded throughout the SDLC. Participate in planning and other ceremonies where applicable to provide support and guidance.
  • Oversee Test Automation Strategy: Guide the design, maintenance, and optimization of automation frameworks. Ensure automation coverage is effective, scalable, and well-integrated into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Manage Test Environments and Data: Coordinate environment setup, data preparation, and version control to ensure test consistency and reliability across manual and automated executions.
  • Monitor and Report on Quality Metrics: Define and track key QA KPIs (e.g., defect density, test coverage, pass rate, release readiness). Use insights to drive continuous improvement.
  • Facilitate Release Readiness and Risk Assessment: Lead go/no‑go decisions based on test outcomes, quality metrics, and known issues. Communicate quality status and risks clearly to stakeholders.
  • Drive Continuous Improvement: Evaluate tools, processes, and team performance to identify opportunities for efficiency and quality enhancement. Champion a culture of learning and proactive defect prevention.
  • 5+ years of experience in Quality Assurance, including both manual and automation testing.
  • 3+ years of proven experience leading QA teams or managing QA processes across multiple projects.
  • Strong understanding of QA methodologies, test design techniques, and SDLC/Agile/Scrum practices.
  • Proficiency in one or more programming/scripting languages (e.g., JavaScript, Python, Java, C#).
  • Proven experience in leading the design and execution of QA strategies across multiple projects.
  • Strong proficiency in planning, scheduling, prioritizing, and coordinating testing activities across teams.

Nice to have

  • Experience with cloud environments and containerization (e.g., AWS, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Certifications: ISTQB Advanced Level, Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), or equivalent QA leadership certification

description:

description:
Quem somos

Na Qive, simplificamos o complexo para impulsionar o crescimento das empresas no Brasil. Transacionamos mais de 3,8 bilhões de notas fiscais e conectamos mais de 140 mil empresas, criando um elo poderoso entre o fiscal e o financeiro. Desde o início, projetamos soluções digitais que revolucionam o dia a dia das pessoas e empresas, sempre com a missão de tornar processos complexos mais simples, eficientes e eficazes.

Sonhamos grande e agimos rápido, enfrentando desafios com entusiasmo e transformando problemas em oportunidades. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a colaboração e o senso de urgência, sempre buscando a excelência em nossas entregas. Aqui, cada pessoa, seja cliente, líder ou colega, desempenha um papel essencial no nosso sucesso coletivo.

Na Qive, estamos comprometidos em mudar a forma como o mercado se relaciona com Documentos Fiscais Eletrônicos (DFes), reduzindo horas operacionais, conomizando custos e mitigando riscos. Nossa cultura é orientada pela inovação, responsabilidade e agilidade, sempre com o objetivo de liderar o mercado e oferecer soluções que impulsionem o crescimento de nossos clientes.

Venha fazer parte dessa revolução e seja o nosso elo para ajudar a construir um futuro mais simples e descomplicado para as empresas brasileiras!

Responsabilidades e objetivos da vaga

  • Conversar com clientes internos, fornecedores, e parceiros para entender contextos e dar vazão para cada situação.
  • Programar para auxiliar ou fazer completamente a integração de sistemas, bem como para termos nossos sistemas auxiliares internos.
  • Gerir os sistemas atuais e auxiliar na contratação de novos.
  • Organiza informações para o dia a dia, preferencialmente em planilhas Google.
  • Atuar na resolução de chamados de demandas diversas da companhia.

Requisitos

  • Conhecimentos intermediários de programação em Python outras linguagens.
  • Conhecimento em banco de dados e APIs REST/WebService.
  • Conhecimentos básicos de administração de sistemas (bancos de dados, Linux, Windows e macOS).
  • Conhecimentos básicos de administração de redes (cabeadas, WiFi, VPNs).
  • Inglês intermediário (boa leitura e escrita, conversação básica).
  • Conhecimento de administração do Google Workspace (antigo GSuite) e suas ferramentas.
  • Conhecimento de IA.

Benefícios

  • Plano de saúde Unimed com cobertura nacional, sem desconto de mensalidade ou coparticipação para nossos Qivers e seus filhos;
  • Plano odontológico com cobertura nacional, sem descontos em folha e possibilidade de inclusão de filhos, parentes, pais e sogros;
  • Benefício Flash Flex com um valor bem competitivo, aceito em restaurantes, supermercados, padarias, mobilidade, bem-estar, saúde, educação, cultura e entretenimento, sem nenhum desconto;
  • Se nós crescemos, nossos Qivers também vem com a gente! Temos um Programa de Participação nos Resultados da empresa (PPR) competitivo com o mercado;
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas, inclusive para adoção e casais homoafetivos;
  • Ajuda de custo ao qiver nos 03 primeiros meses após o nascimento ou adoção no valor de R$ 1.000,00 avançados;
  • Auxílio creche ou babá para filhos de até 06 anos de idade;
  • Total Pass;
  • Cartão Alelo Multibenefícios;
  • Seguro de vida.

E mais

  • Trabalho remoto, liberdade geográfica em qualquer lugar do país;
  • Enviamos todos os equipamentos necessários para montar o seu escritório em casa, mas se você preferir temos uma sede com estacionamento gratuito, lanches e bebidas liberadas e um ambiente super descontraído.;
  • Ambiente de aprendizado e desenvolvimento constante, incentivando o crescimento individual, feedbacks e trabalho em equipe;
  • Valorizamos o bem-estar, por isso temos aulas online e gratuitas de Yoga, Meditação e Ginástica Laboral;
  • Pensando na saúde mental e no desenvolvimento, também temos parceiros como Ana Health, Vamos Escrever e Cambly.

Diversidade é aprendizado e inclusão é necessária na Qive

Estamos em constante aprendizado para garantir que todas as pessoas possuam liberdade e respeito para falar e ouvir e sentir em seu dia a dia as experiências positivas apresentadas pela Qive! Isso é mais do que resolver uma dor em comum, queremos ser melhores sempre, queremos mudar o jogo seja ele qual for. E contamos com você para fazer a diferença e isso independe de sua crença, gênero, orientação sexual, cor de pele, deficiência ou classe social.

Privacidade dos Dados Pessoais

Em nossos processos seletivos coletamos e tratamos os dados pessoais fornecidos no formulário de candidatura da vaga (o que inclui tanto os dados informados em cada campo do formulário, quanto os que estiverem presentes no currículo anexado) e dados que podem ser solicitados nas próximas etapas. A Qive não terá acesso a nenhum outro dado que esteja fora destas hipóteses. A finalidade de coleta é tão somente para identificação, comunicação e análise das pessoas candidatas.

Informamos ainda que realizamos toda a gestão das vagas por meio do sistema InHire, não possuindo vínculo com outras plataformas em que as nossas vagas são espelhadas. Logo, caso você esteja se candidatando às nossas vagas por um meio que não seja o nosso site oficial ou pela InHire, recomenda-se a leitura dos termos e políticas próprias de cada um.

Em caso de dúvidas sobre dados pessoais, entre em contato através dos meios informados em nossa Política de Privacidade.

Programa Talento Inovação – IEL Paraná

O Programa Talento Inovação do IEL Paraná tem como foco selecionar, acompanhar e desenvolver bolsistas, além de coordenar ações com organizações parceiras. Ele convida indústrias a proporem projetos de Pesquisa, Desenvolvimento e Inovação (PD&I) nos quais a participação dos bolsistas promova o crescimento profissional em PD&I empresarial e contribua para a inovação da empresa. O programa oferece bolsas para graduandos, graduados, mestres e doutores, permitindo atividades de PD&I nas instalações das empresas pelo território nacional, após aprovação da Comissão Interna do IEL Paraná.

Projeto: Futuro da Beleza – Vaga afirmativa

Essa vaga afirmativa é para talentos diversos — Pessoa com Deficiência, Pessoas Negras (pretas e pardas), Pessoas 45+, Comunidade LGBTQI+ e Mulheres (Cis e Trans).

Sobre a Oportunidade – Grupo Boticário

No Grupo Boticário, acreditamos que inovar é conectar hoje com o amanhã. O projeto tem como propósito apoiar a equipe de Inovação Estratégica de Produtos na estratégia do projeto Futuro da Beleza, identificando as rotas tecnológicas de produto mais promissoras para os próximos anos. Nosso objetivo é traduzir tendências em oportunidades concretas, transformando ciência e tecnologia em valor para milhões de consumidores.

Aqui, você terá a oportunidade de explorar territórios de inovação já mapeados, caracterizar e quantificar rotas tecnológicas a partir da análise de ICTs, empresas e startups, além de colaborar com áreas estratégicas como marketing, foresight, categoria (embalagem e formulação) e pesquisa.

O resultado esperado é a conexão entre a estratégia de inovação de curto prazo e as de médio e longo prazo, garantindo maior eficiência na identificação de oportunidades tecnológicas em PD&I. Se você tem perfil analítico, curiosidade para explorar novas fronteiras da ciência e vontade de gerar impacto real no futuro da beleza, que desejam cocriar conosco o amanhã da beleza.

Formação Acadêmica

  • Realizar buscas em bases de dados já pré-definidas na metodologia, mapear e consolidar as tecnologias levantadas.
  • Fazer a análise crítica dos dados obtidos e cruzar com estratégia de inovação do Grupo Boticário.
  • Caracterizar as rotas tecnológicas identificadas de acordo com metodologia pré-definida.
  • Calibrar pesquisa com consumidores e realizar consolidação do material e análise crítica dos resultados.
  • Construir a apresentação do relatório final.

title: Ad Tech Developer – Header Bidding
description:
At MonetizeMore, we’re all about using data to transform how the advertising industry tackles IVT (Invalid Traffic) and fraud prevention. Our products deliver real impact—and we need top-tier talent to help sell this premium AI product to better protect ad monetized publishers and ad tech vendors.

For 15 years, we’ve been driven by a team of 100+ talented professionals across the globe. As a 100% remote and culture-centric organization, we are built on the core pillars of Integrity, Collaboration, Enterprising, and Kaizen, ensuring excellence in everything we do.

About the Role

MonetizeMore is seeking an Ad Tech Developer with in-depth expertise in header bidding to build, optimize, and scale programmatic monetization for premium publishers. You’ll own end-to-end header bidding implementations (with a heavy focus on Prebid.js), improve auction performance, and partner with product, yield, and publisher success teams to deliver revenue-lifting results with excellent user experience.

What You’ll Do

  • Design & implement header bidding stacks using Prebid.js (web) and related wrappers; configure bidders, floors, price granularity, userId modules, and analytics.
  • Customize & extend adapters/modules (e.g., userId, analytics, consent) and contribute clean, documented JavaScript/TypeScript code.
  • Integrate with GAM/Ad Manager (GPT): line item strategy, key-values, creative templates, and troubleshooting of delivery and competition.
  • Optimize auctions & latency: tune timeouts, s2s vs. client, floors, ad refresh logic, and page performance (CLS/LCP/INP/Core Web Vitals).
  • Run experiments: A/B test bidders, formats, and page placements; build dashboards to track impact (e.g., eCPM, viewability, fill, latency).
  • Debug complex issues across browser, network, and auction layers (DevTools, HAR/Waterfall, Charles/Proxyman); resolve revenue dips & bidder errors.
  • Implement privacy & compliance: IAB TCF, GDPR/CCPA/CPRA, CMP integration, consent storage, and geo-specific behaviors.
  • Work with partners: SSPs, exchanges, ID providers, and analytics vendors to launch new demand and troubleshoot.
  • Ship quality safely: use Git, CI/CD, code review, and observability to keep releases fast and reliable.
  • Document & mentor: write clear runbooks and help level up teammates.

What You’ll Bring

  • 3–6+ years of front-end or full-stack experience with a strong JavaScript foundation (TypeScript a plus).
  • 2–4+ years hands-on with header bidding (Prebid.js required); experience with s2s/managed wrappers (e.g., Prebid Server, Amazon TAM/UAM) is a plus.
  • Solid understanding of Google Ad Manager (GAM/GPT) setups, line items & creatives, key-values, targeting, and delivery debugging.
  • Working knowledge of programmatic concepts: OpenRTB, floors, auction dynamics, user sync/ID, brand safety, and viewability.
  • Familiarity with privacy frameworks & CMPs (IAB TCF v2.x, GDPR/CCPA/CPRA) and consent-aware ad serving.
  • Performance tuning for Core Web Vitals and modern build tools (Webpack/Vite/Rollup).
  • Comfort with Chrome DevTools, network waterfalls, and log-driven debugging; bonus points for Node.js, Cloud Functions, or simple backend endpoints.
  • Data fluency: basic SQL or BI tools (Looker/Data Studio/BigQuery) for revenue & latency analysis.
  • Clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders; bias for automation and measurable outcomes.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with app/webview monetization, AMP, or SPA frameworks (React/Vue/Svelte).
  • Prebid analytics adapters or custom reporting pipelines.
  • Experience with ads.txt/app-ads.txt, sellers.json, supply chain object.
  • Knowledge of brand safety & IVT controls, creative QA, and MRC viewability standards.
  • Exposure to video (IMA/OMSDK, Prebid Video, VAST/VPAID/VMAP) or CTV/OTT.
  • Knowledge in Python and NoSQL is a plus.

Why MonetizeMore

  • Remote-first culture with flexible work hours.
  • Impact at scale across a large publisher network.
  • Smart, low-ego teammates and a culture of experimentation.
  • Competitive compensation, performance bonus, home-office stipend, and learning budget.

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Managers of Information Technology, Ledn is interested in hearing from you!
Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future.
We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world.
Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients — in real terms. Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds.
What we all have in common is an unshakeable conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn's suite of products & services can play a critical role in doing so.
The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy.
Combining these values with our conviction makes Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better.
Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full‑time Manager of IT.
The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud‑based IT systems and tools.
A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security‑first environments.
The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code.
But, just as passionate about helping end users who are in need of help. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks.
You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever‑changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment.
You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast‑moving and highly execution‑oriented team. You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR.

About the Role

This role will report to the Director of IT. You will be customer‑facing, and the first line of support; you own support and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We’re all Mac.
You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment. You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees.
You’ll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background. You’ll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc. You’ll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.). You’ll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork.
Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion. You’re comfortable juggling help desk tickets and can effectively prioritise them. You’ll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you’re experienced with agile methods and sprints).

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilise open‑source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • Do you integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta.
  • You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another.
  • You’ve provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you’re familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time‑poor without losing your cool.
  • You write very well, whether it’s in tickets, email or Slack.
  • You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures.
  • A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win.
  • You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is.
  • You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching.
  • You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone’s time.
  • You can self‑manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams.
  • Strong organisational and task‑management skills are critical.
  • You’re comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data.

Nice to Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS (you will not need certifications, but you will have used these environments a bit.)
  • You’ve used tools like GAM and command‑line interfaces to do lots of work with less effort.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

We’re looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values.
The ideal candidate will:
• Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high‑growth, fast‑paced environment.
• Have a builder’s mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IT practices.
• Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
• Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
• Have worked in a remote environment before.
• Taste of What We Provide.

What We Provide

As one of the world’s leading digital asset companies, we provide tremendous growth opportunities. A comprehensive, best‑in‑class total rewards package that starts on your first day!
We offer a competitive PTO package that ensures you have the time off you deserve. Ownership in the company.
Through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company and the future of the digital economy. We offer every employee the opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
A career that provides you with purpose in your job. We remove barriers so you love what you do.

Equal Opportunity Statement

We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity.
You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing ****** for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process.
Requests will be addressed confidentially.

Working Environment

Our Ledn team is truly global in nature with our people spanning across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe.

Estamos em busca de pessoas engajadas, que tenham brilho no olho e muita vontade de se desenvolver e crescer com a gente.

Main responsibilities

Como Product Owner Senior (ProdOPS) , seu papel será garantir a saúde e evolução operacional do produto , transformando incidentes e demandas do dia a dia em oportunidades de melhoria contínua. Buscamos um profissional sênior de ProdOPS, com experiência comprovada em sustentação e operação de produtos digitais complexos.

Você atuará junto a desenvolvedores, Suporte e CX, conectando tecnologia e operação para manter a performance, reduzir gargalos e fortalecer a experiência dos nossos usuários e parceiros internos .

  • Assegurar a continuidade e a excelência operacional do produto, garantindo estabilidade, performance e disponibilidade em todos os ambientes;
  • Atuar como elo estratégico entre Tecnologia, Suporte e CX, priorizando e direcionando resoluções de incidentes, bugs e melhorias com base em impacto e valor para o negócio;
  • Gerir o fluxo de demandas e tickets com visão crítica, estruturando processos que tragam previsibilidade, priorização clara e agilidade na execução;
  • Analisar causas-raiz e padrões recorrentes, liderando junto ao time ações corretivas e preventivas que reduzam falhas e aumentem a confiabilidade do sistema;
  • Identificar e acompanhar evoluções incrementais de produto, desde ajustes técnicos até melhorias de usabilidade que tornem a operação mais fluida e sustentável;
  • Garantir comunicação estruturada com stakeholders e demais squads, consolidando informações sobre incidentes, planos de ação e status de resolução com clareza executiva;
  • Atuar com liderança e serenidade em situações críticas, conduzindo priorizações e decisões sob pressão com foco em estabilidade e transparência;
  • Consolidar aprendizados e evoluções da operação, transformando-os em boas práticas e processos que reforcem a maturidade e previsibilidade da tribo.

Requirements and skills

Para ser o nosso novo talento você precisa:

  • Perfil sênior, analítico e proativo , com domínio de metodologias e mentalidade ProdOPS ;
  • Capacidade de atuar com estrutura e serenidade em ambientes de alta demanda ;
  • Visão crítica e curiosidade genuína para melhorar processos e antecipar riscos;
  • Boa escuta, empatia e habilidade para integrar tecnologia, suporte e negócio;
  • Autonomia para agir e discernimento para escalar, equilibrando urgência e estratégia ;
  • Paixão por garantir estabilidade, previsibilidade e evolução contínua de produtos digitais ;
  • Capacidade analítica para identificar padrões, causas-raiz e indicadores operacionais, transformando dados em planos de ação concretos ;
  • Habilidade de navegar entre o técnico e o estratégico , traduzindo necessidades do negócio para o time de desenvolvimento e vice-versa;
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e relacionamento , com postura colaborativa e capacidade de alinhar decisões sob pressão ;
  • Perfil resiliente, estruturado e orientado à melhoria contínua , com senso de urgência equilibrado e foco em resultado mensurável .

E os seguintes conhecimentos e experiências:

  • Experiência sólida em operações de produto digital (ProdOPS, Sustentação ou Gestão de Incidentes) , com histórico de atuação em produtos SaaS de alta criticidade ;
  • Domínio das principais práticas e frameworks de ProdOPS , como ITSM, Problem Management, Incident Response e Continuous Improvement;
  • Experiência em coordenação de fluxos operacionais e gestão de demandas , com domínio de priorização baseada em impacto, risco e urgência;
  • Vivência em ambientes ágeis, com alto volume de tickets, múltiplas squads e interações entre times de CX, Suporte e Tecnologia ;
  • Experiência prática com ferramentas de gestão de incidentes e backlog (Jira, Movidesk, ClickUp, Zendesk, Freshdesk, etc.);
  • Conhecimento de métricas operacionais (SLA, MTTR, TTR, taxa de reabertura, volume e severidade de incidentes);
  • Conhecimento e experiência com estratégias data driven , consumo de dados e clareza nos insights para gerar ações práticas;
  • Experiência na condução de post-mortems, análises de causa-raiz e rituais de melhoria contínua (Kaizen, RCA, 5 Whys, PDCA);
  • Vivência com gestão de crise e incident response , atuando em cenários de alta pressão com clareza e priorização;
  • Vivência em times com metodologias ágeis para desenvolvimento;
  • Interesse em automação de processos operacionais, integrações leves, monitoramentos e scripts de apoio (altamente desejável);
  • Conhecimento em SQL, Postman ou ferramentas de inspeção técnica (diferencial).

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion, and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities.
